paper_title: Before Generation, Align it! A Novel and Effective Strategy for   Mitigating Hallucinations in Text-to-SQL Generation
caption: Results of different schema linking modules on BIRD-dev.
model_annotation: The bar chart illustrates the recall, precision, and F1 score achieved by different schema linking modules, specifically DIN-SQL and TA-SQL, when evaluated on the BIRD-dev dataset. The horizontal axis, representing the categories, displays the module names: DIN-SQL (zero-shot), TA-SQL (zero-shot), and DIN-SQL (few-shot), ordered from left to right. The vertical axis, labeled “Recall, Precision, and F1 Score,” ranges from 0 to 100, utilizing a linear scale. The values are displayed as numerical values along the vertical axis, with tick labels spaced at intervals of 10. The bar representing DIN-SQL (zero-shot) has a height of approximately 63.58, while the bar for TA-SQL (zero-shot) reaches approximately 71.90. The DIN-SQL (few-shot) bar is the tallest, with a height of approximately 75.34.  The TA-SQL (zero-shot) bar reaches a height of 80.40, and the DIN-SQL (few-shot) bar reaches 81.08. All bars are presented in shades of blue and green, respectively, and no bars are visually emphasized.
